newsitem.title: USA: Zytec sees higher Q2 sales, lower Q3, Q4.
newsitem.headline: Zytec sees higher Q2 sales, lower Q3, Q4.

text.p: Zytec Corp said on Monday it expected sales for its second quarter ended June 30 to be about 20 percent higher than first quarter sales of $57.6 million, with earnings keeping pace with sales growth.

The company also said it expected its third and fourth quarter results to be below those of the second quarter, but sales in the second half would still be somewhat higher than those in the first half.

"We continue to see strong order indications from our customers, particularly the internetworking companies, which currently account for more than 60 percent of our sales," Ronald Schmidt, chairman and chief executive, said.
Schmidt said he expected earnings growth to keep pace in both the second quarter and the second half.

"As previously reported we had a record 16 new product wins in our first quarter, compared with 20 in all of 1996 and 16 in 1995," he said. "While these new products will have little effect on sales in 1997, they should be indicative of continued strong sales growth for Zytec going forward."
